Name: Animated Eyeball Sprinklers
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lpmkRfk.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]It is said that their tears never stop, some also say those tears are so powerful that even plants will grow! There is tales of a curse, maybe a witch, beast or fairy?
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/2TX6iAE.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]This mod can be used to replace sprinklers with animated eye monsters, there is 6 colors and 3 different tear options (normal, acid and dark), pairs well with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14063]AT - Eyeball Scarecrows[/url][/size].[size=3]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=3][url=https://elthen.itch.io/2d-pixel-art-flying-eye-monster]Flying Eye Monster sprite[/url]﻿ by [url=https://elthen.itch.io/]Elthen[/url] :D﻿[/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]﻿
[center][/center][center][size=3][b]1[/b]. Download this mod and Alternative Textures

[b]2[/b]. Drop everything in the mods folder

[b]3[/b]. Buy the paint bucket from Robin and use it on any sprinkler

[b]4[/b].  Enjoy!
